gates.G3_FC: PASS WITH CAVEAT — 2,004 rows (636 unique collection events across 119 participants) have valid numeric FC; dual columns (fecalcal and fecalcal_ng_ml) must be combined via combine_first.

C1_future_fc_prediction.evidence: 90 unique participants (66 IBD: CD/UC) have >=2 visits with both MGX and same-day FC, yielding 445 consecutive index-to-next-FC pairs (1671 all-future pairs; 415 in 14-56d; 545 in 30-90d). Limitation: FC is missing in 68.1% of MGX visits (522/1638 present), and independent participant count (90 with >=2 MGX+FC visits [66 IBD]; 93 with >=1 MGX+FC index visit and a future FC [69 IBD]) requires parsimonious models (Elastic Net / Random Forest) rather than deep learning.
C1_future_fc_prediction.remaining_blockers: Principal investigator must freeze the primary forecast horizon (e.g. next-visit within 14-56d vs 30-90d) and confirm whether nonIBD controls are excluded from C1 training (PRD 4.2 specifies CD/UC).

C2_taxonomic_analysis.evidence: Both MetaPhlAn2 (1,638 samples x 1,479 clades) and MetaPhlAn3 (1,638 samples x 932 clades) shotgun WGS taxonomic profiles are downloaded, verified, and 100% matched (1,638/1,638) to metadata External IDs across 130 participants. Biopsy 16S (178 samples) and Pilot Stool 16S (58 samples) are also available.
C2_taxonomic_analysis.remaining_blockers: Must choose between MetaPhlAn2 (original publication baseline) and MetaPhlAn3 (updated taxonomy) before freezing P2.

C2_functional_analysis.evidence: Shotgun WGS functional potential profiles are downloaded and 100% matched (1,638/1,638 samples): HUMAnN2 MetaCyc pathways (10,884 features), HUMAnN3 MetaCyc pathways (22,113 features), HUMAnN2 EC enzymes (108,433 features), and HUMAnN3 EC enzymes (167,854 features, 1,635 samples). Additionally, active RNA expression (MTX HUMAnN2 pathways/ECs, 735 samples) and fecal proteomics (450 samples) are available for separate comparison.
C2_functional_analysis.remaining_blockers: Retain strict distinction between metagenomic DNA potential (MGX) and metatranscriptomic RNA expression (MTX).

C3_uncertainty_evaluation.evidence: Participant-grouped 70/15/15 split yields 65 train, 14 calibration, and 14 test participants (overlap=0). However, calibration partition has only ~13 independent participants (~10 IBD).
C3_uncertainty_evaluation.remaining_blockers: With ~10-13 calibration participants, participant-level split-conformal quantiles have high finite-sample variance; recommend cross-conformal / CV+ grouped by participant rather than a single 15% calibration holdout.

C4_dietary_pattern_support.evidence: 21 longitudinal food-frequency variables (yogurt, dairy, probiotics, fruits, vegetables, beans, whole grains, starch, eggs, processed/red/white meat, shellfish, fish, sweets, beverages) are recorded in >98% of MGX visits (~1,600/1,638), alongside diagnosis (100%), medications/antibiotics (100%), HBI (693 MGX rows), and SCCAI (452 MGX rows).
C4_dietary_pattern_support.remaining_blockers: IBDMDB records coarse food-group recall frequencies, not standardized Mediterranean or SCD adherence scores; DINE-CD and clinical guidelines (AGA/ECCO/BDA) must be curated externally to build the R1-R3 evidence knowledgebase.

external_validation_IBSEN_III.evidence: IBSEN III and DINE-CD datasets are not present locally and require external institutional data-access requests.
external_validation_IBSEN_III.remaining_blockers: Submit external data request for IBSEN III; note that 16S external cohorts can only validate genus-level taxonomic models, not shotgun functional pathways.
